fixed_parent_entry: First completed 3h negative histogram improving with 3h Stoch K rising and >=D after >=2x historical RMS oversold 3h arm. Next 15m RTH open. One original parent arm, at most one parent-entry candidate.
source: same 15m historical Terminal RTH snapshots as v14/15/16; no 24h BOATS, PIT/bid-ask not independently verified
risk_and_economics: 1.5% hard emergency stop, 25% profit-taking at +2%, 5bp/side, 52 observed RTH-hour time cap, next-bar-open signal, stop-first OHLC
first_order_question: On exactly the same parent-turn entry episodes, measure average delta vs time52, losers saved (not necessarily made profitable), previous winners harmed, residual winners, stop times, and per original extreme-episode opportunity results. Overlap and right-censorship separate.
analysis_gates: No threshold search or reoptimization on current year. Compare both 15m and 30m lower detectors; include no signal and time controls. Do not infer a trade was marketable at exact OHLC price.
risk_conservative: No sizing recommendations, no stop widening, no pyramiding, no quote-staleness beyond venue evidence.
